description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) LAYERED CERAMITE (Ironstorm Spearhead, 1 CP, any phase) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. A REAL click opens the S (stratagem) panel; a REAL click on LAYERED CERAMITE's Use button opens the target picker (only ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units); a REAL click on the Gladiator Lancer spends 1 CP; it has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds this phase.
